Gamer.name: Gamer
Gamer.description:
🎮 You spent late nights on online matches, speedruns and strategy games.

🏆 A few tournament trophies sit at home.
🧠 You think in strategies and know your way around a computer.

📈 Grants: Combat Tactics +5, Computing +5
Gamer.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up on competitive games: reading patterns, timing cooldowns and planning team plays. They are at home with computers and online communities, and they talk about fights in game terms.
